subject.title: Fix container image upgrade migrations before gateway readiness

question: Should foreground container gateway startup run state migrations plus post-core plugin convergence before readiness, including configured-plugin package repair when the existing convergence path decides it is needed?
rationale: The patch fixes a real false-ready container upgrade path, but it intentionally moves upgrade and package-repair work into gateway startup and can change existing operator availability behavior.

options.title: Accept startup convergence after docs fix
options.body: Proceed with startup performing update-equivalent safe convergence work before readiness after the docs clearly describe package repair and failure behavior.

options.title: Limit startup to state-only gating
options.body: Keep the version checkpoint and state migration readiness gate, but leave configured-plugin package repair to explicit update or doctor flows.

options.title: Keep convergence explicit
options.body: Do not move post-core convergence into startup; instead fail with a clear repair command when a version transition is detected.

recommendation.title: Accept startup convergence after docs fix
recommendation.body: Proceed with startup performing update-equivalent safe convergence work before readiness after the docs clearly describe package repair and failure behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the closest recent gateway startup bootstrap boundary that this PR extends.
